citations.assessment: The primary text gives the questions addressed to Levi. After Levi dies, Shemuel asks Rav Menashya to answer. The passage has no Dovil epithet.
A variant attribution has Rav Menashya reporting Shemuel’s tefillin ruling. This digital witness agrees with Heilprin’s statement that Dovil is absent there.
Rav Yosef son of Rav Menashe of Dovil sends a question about a divorce rumor to Shemuel. The epithet is explicit here.
The linked Yosef entry explicitly has the father’s Dovil epithet and the same folio.
